description: Milestone 1 of the real-protocol tests: jupiterOracleCheckedSwap, tokenSweepIntoSwap, pythFreshPriceGate and jitoProfitGuardedTip, which need only Jupiter, Pyth and Jito. The snapshot also takes every executable a route references, listed here or not. All three AMMs in `jupiter.dexes` are listed because Jupiter's pick among them changes every few seconds, so any refresh may route through any of them; listing them keeps the snapshot's program set the same from one refresh to the next.

wallet.description: The tests sign with Keypair::new_from_array(*b"ballista-protocol-tests-wallet-1"). Jupiter builds every route for this wallet, so the routes' token accounts are its associated token accounts, which the tests write themselves.

jupiter.description: Classic AMMs only: they are deterministic and change only when traded. The prop AMMs that dominate SOL-USDC reprice every slot and read the instructions sysvar or a vote account.

solToUsdc.description: 1 SOL for USDC: the oracle-checked swap, and the action behind the Pyth price gate.

usdcToSol.description: 150 USDC for SOL: the token sweep.

solToUsdcToSol.description: A SOL round trip for the Jito tip. Jupiter's API refuses a quote whose input and output mints are equal (CIRCULAR_ARBITRAGE_IS_DISABLED), so this is two chained quotes: 1 SOL for USDC, then that quote's whole outAmount back to SOL. Each leg is its own route instruction with its own accounts. Stitching both into one route, with a two-step plan whose second step reads the first's output, is left to the test that needs it.
